content_zh: 仇英与沈周、文徵明、唐寅被后世并称为明四家。此并称为后世美术史家的归纳分类，仇英生前不存在明四家这一固定组织。仇英出身寒微，为职业画家，与另三人文人出身背景截然不同。
content_en: Qiu Ying is grouped as one of the Four Masters of the Ming. This is a later art-historical classification, not an organized group during his lifetime. His humble professional-painter background differs markedly from the literati backgrounds of the other three.

content_zh: 大量署名仇英的传世画作存在真伪争议。明清时期仇英画风广受欢迎，产生大量代笔和仿作。署名仇英并不等同于确凿真迹。
content_en: Many paintings bearing Qiu Ying's signature have disputed authenticity. His popular style generated numerous ghost-painted works and imitations in the Ming-Qing period.

content_zh: 传仇英由漆工自学成画师之说，虽广为流传，原始出处需核实。此说反映了仇英职业画家出身寒微的历史记忆，但细节可能有后世附会成分。
content_en: The widely circulated story of Qiu Ying rising from lacquer craftsman to master painter reflects his humble origins but the specific details may contain later embellishment.
